page_note: Page is entirely Manichaean ecclesial-institutional material: opens with Sunday/communion/fast, then chapter heading 'Commandments of Righteousness,' followed by systematic exposition of Elect praxis (continence, purity of begetting, rest of hands from cross of light, no flesh/blood/wine) under 'first righteousness,' then 'second righteousness' (wisdom/faith/love giving) culminating in becoming a 'perfect Elect,' then turn to Catechumen with fast/prayer/almsgiving. The 'first/second/third' enumeration here is NOT cosmological substrate enumeration — both sides of every mapping reach into the editor's institutional world (Elect rules, Catechumen rules). Editorial fatigue score confirms: ecclesial vocabulary 9.0→59.4 across halves. No cosmological substrate present on this page.
